chunks: Indeed he saw some of the greatest signs of His Lord.
ai.seo_question: What are the greatest signs (Ayat) that the Prophet Muhammad saw?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is pivotal for establishing the authenticity of the Prophet's visionary experiences, with scholars debating whether the 'greatest signs' refer specifically to the Mi'raj or the broader spectrum of divine revelations. It underscores the unique spiritual station of the Prophet (SAWW) as the ultimate witness to the unseen, reinforcing the concept of *Haqq al-Yaqin* (truth of certainty) in his prophetic mission.
